versions.content: When receiving a request for UDS Service RoutineControl (0x31) with subfunction stopRoutine, if all verifications have been successfully done (see [SWS_Dcm_00568], [SWS_Dcm_00570], [SWS_Dcm_00571]), the Dcm module shall call the configured Xxx_Stop() function passing the dataIn, calculated from routineCon- trolOptionRecord (see [SWS_Dcm_00590]), and the dataOut reference according of the list of output signal configured for this routine ( see configuration parameter DcmD- spStopRoutineOut ).
